formula_per_job: cost = compute_seconds (CPU user+sys of the job process and its fluidsynth/ffmpeg children) x COST_PER_CPU_SECOND
cost_per_cpu_second_note: COST_PER_CPU_SECOND default (= $0.048 per vCPU-hour); an assumption, set it to your server's price
paid_services_runtime: none (no paid API, cloud or GPU used to produce or measure outputs)
